endpoint.name: Company live job postings by website — LinkedIn, Indeed
endpoint.summary: Fetches live LinkedIn and Indeed job listings for a company, including title, location, description, compensation, experience level, and extracted key skills.
endpoint.platform_blocked: upstream 403 'Your current subscription does not include access to this endpoint' on treg's shared Akta key (alternative-data tier; re-probed 2026-07-31). Works with your own Akta key on a plan that includes Alternative Signals.

cost.note: 4 Akta credits per 10 job listings returned (llms-full.txt sample response)

company.note: company website (e.g. 'canva.com') or a company UUID from Company Search

limit.note: max job listings to return, default 10

offset.note: listings to skip before returning records, default 0

input.note: synchronous GET; response also reports total open-role count and credits consumed.
